description: Repair the canonical scanner's repeatable out-of-memory failure on the Reading Advantage monorepo while preserving deterministic graph semantics, atomic publication, and installed-artifact truth.
deviation_notes: The behavior-preserving indexed symbol slice removed the two verified superlinear lookups and preserved normalized self-graph semantics. The first real-consumer candidate avoided OOM but timed out after 900 seconds at 2,313,020 KiB peak RSS, missing the 35% reduction ceiling and never reaching persistence; package-batched scanning is therefore required.
